rates.name: energy only: measured 251 W at EUR 0.3/kWh

claude.label: the Claude Code CLI's list-price estimate with 25 messages per call and prompt caching; not a measured API bill, and not a charge on a subscription

assumptions.usd_to_eur_note: parity is a simplification used only to put both costs in one currency for the break-even volume; scale the break-even by your own exchange rate
assumptions.note: None of the hourly rates is a quoted market price. Energy-only excludes hardware, hosting and staff. The measured power is whole-GPU draw on a shared card.

break_even_logic: A dedicated GPU costs the same whether it handles 10 or 10,000 requests an hour, so the small model is cheaper only above the break-even volume = hourly GPU rate / Claude cost per request.
